title: Trajectory Notebook — Q2 manager prep & self-check
content:
Purpose: quick personal ledger to use before 1:1s and the Q2 calibration. Not a polished narrative — capture signals, asks, and small experiments I want to try.

Top-line (one sentence): move from reactive hiring ops to a proactive onboarding cadence that reduces new hire time-to-product by 20% and raises first-90-day activation NPS by +8 points.

What success looks like (signals I can point to):
- Time-to-product (feature contribution or billable bench): down from ~42 days to ~34 days for ICs on eng-onboarding path (tracked in HR dashboard).
- New hire activation NPS: baseline 62 -> target 70+.
- Two repeatable onboarding templates (Eng general + Eng infra) adopted by hiring managers, measured via checklist completion in 1st 2 weeks.
- Manager feedback loop set up (weekly 15-min async form) with 80% completion rate.

Concrete accomplishments since last sync:
- Rolled out shadow pairing pilot with infra team (3 hires so far) — initial anecdotal feedback positive: pairing shortened setup friction.
- Built a short checklist template in Confluence for infra onboarding (link above).
- Reduced average provisioning delay for laptops from 6 to 3 business days with new vendor SLA and playbook (vendor ticket PO-4821).

Evidence to surface in 1:1 (what I will bring):
- CSV export of onboarding checklist completion by cohort (Feb cohort vs Jan).
- Slack snippets from two managers praising the shadow pairing approach.
- Vendor SLA contract excerpt and cost delta (ops budget note).

Open questions / calibration asks for manager:
- Prioritization: is reducing time-to-laptop more valuable this quarter than improving 1st-week content? I think both, but need alignment on where to put design hours.
- Headcount: request for 0.5 FTE contractor for three months to build modular onboarding modules (estimate: 120 hours).
- Escalation path: confirm who owns cross-team infra blockers beyond SRE (I propose platform-eng liaison).

Risk log (brief):
- Shadow pairing scales poorly if managers don't make time — mitigation: create a 30-min pairing template and make it asynchronous when needed.
- Vendor SLA improves speed but increases cost ~3% — track in ops budget and propose offset via reduced lost ramp time.

Micro experiments to run this quarter:
1) Office-hours drop-in (30-min weekly) for new hires during week 1 — measure attendance and first-week NPS. Time: 4 hrs prep + weekly host.
2) Manager async check-in form (3 q) sent after day 7 — measure completion and correlate with 90-day activation. Built as Google Form; link to results in dashboard.
3) Pairing playbook A/B: synchronous 1:1 pairing vs recorded walkthrough + async Q&A. Randomize cohorts and compare time-to-product.

Manager prep bullets (things I want from you):
- Quick read on which initiative you want prioritized if we need to drop something (laptop provisioning vs content design vs pairing scale).
- Feedback on contractor ask and whether comp budget can absorb 0.5 FTE for Q2.
- Introductions: can you introduce me to lead of platform-eng to align on infra blocker ownership?

Requests I will make in the sync:
- Approval to post the pairing playbook to the eng handbook and re-run the pilot with two more teams.
- OK to run the contractor posting this week (I have a 2-page brief and 5 sample tasks).

Personal reflection / growth notes (for manager coaching):
- Strength: excel at process iteration and rapid prototyping (ship small playbooks quickly).
- Stretch area: cross-org influence — want help practicing concise ask framing for exec stakeholders.
- Quick ask: can we do a 15-min role-play in the next 1:1 where I present the contractor ask and you give direct live feedback?

Next steps / immediate TODOs after this doc:
- Attach CSV + two Slack snippets to the 1:1 agenda. (Due: 2026-03-07)
- Draft contractor brief and shared shortlist of tasks (Due: 2026-03-09).
- Set up A/B pilot groups and finalize measurement plan with Lina (Due: 2026-03-12).

Random notes / scratch ideas (sprint-y, messy):
- Consider a micro-badging system ("provisioned", "paired", "first-PR") to give visible signals to managers. Could be just a Confluence tag or a row in HR dashboard.
- Low-friction feedback: add 1-click NPS in the onboarding Slack channel (emoji based) after key milestones.
- Potentially reuse part of the external candidate onboarding content for contractors to reduce double-work.

Slack threads & refs:
- #people-ops-squad: pairing pilot feedback (search "shadow pairing")
- #eng-onboarding: manager notes thread (pinged Ethan for additional quotes)

Quick metrics snapshot (to paste in sync):
- Current avg time-to-product: 42 days (Jan cohort)
summary: Personal scratchpad for Sofia Patel capturing Q2 onboarding priorities, evidence, asks for manager, and micro experiments to reduce time-to-product and improve activation NPS.
